label_definition: No qualifying purchase during the 90 days after each cutoff
validation_method: Train on two earlier point-in-time customer snapshots and test on the latest snapshot. Earlier label windows end before the final test cutoff. Customers may recur across snapshots; this is point-in-time temporal validation, not a fully customer-disjoint test.
caveats: A temporal split is more realistic than a random split, but only one final cutoff is tested.
Customers may occur in multiple snapshots; interpret this as repeated point-in-time scoring.
The dataset is historical and ends in 2011; results may not generalize to current retail behavior.
ROC-AUC and precision targets are goals, not guaranteed outcomes.
Unit cost and inventory fields are not used because source values are unavailable or unverified.
